components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Single high-emphasis action per viewport region (start next subtest, continue practice, import pack).
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Mulai Latihan <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--accent, #2563eb); color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #1d4ed8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-text, #1d4ed8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Outlined Button
components.description: Standard action for non-primary subtest rows, retake triggers, and secondary navigation.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: var(--bg-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text-primary, #0f172a); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #cbd5e1); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle, #f1f5f9); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-text, #1d4ed8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: Active state for persistent learner sidebar and admin topbar navigation.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: var(--accent-soft, #eff6ff); color: var(--accent-text, #1d4ed8); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-text, #1d4ed8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Question Type Badge
components.description: Micro status chip identifying subtest question mechanics (Gambar, Memori 5 dtk, Kecepatan).
components.css: .ds-chip-memory { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: #fffbeb; color: #92400e; border: 1px solid #fde68a; border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Catalog and admin filter input with hairline border and crisp cobalt focus state.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="search" placeholder="Cari perusahaan atau paket..." />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 260px; background: var(--bg-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--text-primary, #0f172a); border: 1px solid var(--border-default, #e2e8f0); border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 12px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted, #526075); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #2563eb); }

components.name: Exam Option Row
components.description: Selectable answer option with monospace keycap badge and clear active outline.
components.css: .ds-option-selected { display: flex; width: 320px; align-items: center; gap: 14px; background: var(--accent-soft, #eff6ff); color: var(--text-primary, #0f172a); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent, #2563eb); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; } .ds-keycap { display: inline-flex; width: 24px; height: 24px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent, #2563eb); color: #ffffff; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: e-assessment adopts the Modern EdTech category standard calibrated to the clarity and craft level of Dicoding, Coursera, and Linear. Every surface is built for sustained cognitive focus: candidates preparing for multi-company recruitment exams need immediate orientation across companies, packages, and local progress, followed by a distraction-free workspace during timed subtests and an effortless mistake-review flow afterward. The system deliberately rejects gamified noise, saturated decoration, nested card stacks, and uppercase eyebrow kickers.
keyCharacteristics: Persistent 260px left sidebar on learner views paired with a distraction-free, sidebar-free Focus Exam Mode during active timed subtests.
Lightweight topbar CMS layout for admin pack management without heavy navigation chrome.
High-contrast light and dark modes with dedicated accessible text accents (#1D4ED8 light / #60A5FA dark) separated from solid button fills (#2563EB).
Strict numeric discipline: tabular-nums across all counts and JetBrains Mono reserved strictly for timers, score ratios, slugs, and JSON payloads.
Uniform 1.75px stroke inline SVG icon library replacing Unicode symbols and emojis.

rules.name: The Single Primary Action Rule
rules.body: Reserve solid Primary Cobalt (#2563eb) for at most one primary call-to-action in any viewport region. Secondary actions, non-next subtest rows, and pre-completion submit triggers remain crisp outlined surfaces.

rules.name: The Split Accent Contrast Rule
rules.body: Never reuse a mid-blue fill color directly as small text on dark translucent surfaces. Always pair solid fills (--accent: #2563eb) with dedicated text accents (--accent-text: #1d4ed8 light / #60a5fa dark).

rules.name: The Earned Monospace Rule
rules.body: Use JetBrains Mono strictly for timers, score ratios/percentages, slugs, <kbd> shortcut chips, and JSON code. General prose counts stay in Inter with tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Never stack bordered cards inside bordered cards. Group related items inside a single 12px-radius panel separated by 1px horizontal dividers.

dos: Do preserve a single clear primary #2563eb CTA per view (such as highlighting only the next unfinished subtest in a package).
Do use --accent-text (#1d4ed8 light / #60a5fa dark) for blue text, active nav states, and links to guarantee WCAG AA contrast in both themes.
Do keep currentColor SVG question plates inside a softly contrasted neutral frame so diagrams stay sharp in both light and dark modes.
Do provide skeleton loading states (loading.tsx), empty states that explain the next step, and inline confirmation before destructive CMS deletes.
donts: Don't place uppercase eyebrow/kicker labels above headings — let breadcrumbs and headings carry their own hierarchy.
Don't nest bordered cards inside other bordered cards or apply colored border-left/border-right stripes wider than 1px.
Don't use font-mono for non-measurement UI prose or Unicode emojis in place of the 1.75px stroke SVG icon set.
Don't expose answer keys or explanations in client payloads before /api/attempts scores a submission on the server.
